title: Đề luyện Nói VSTEP — Review FTU HN 22/8/2026

questions.content:
speaking — Part 1

In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about telling lies, and then about having a healthy diet.

speaking — Part 2

Situation: You order a meal at a restaurant, but the waiter brings you something different from what you ordered. You are considering the following options: 1. Politely asking the waiter to change the dish for you 2. Informing the restaurant and asking for your money back 3. Reporting the problem to the manager Which one would you choose? Why?

speaking — Part 3

Topic: More and more people record and share videos online every day. Talk about the benefits of sharing videos on the Internet. Ideas: - Earning money - Becoming famous - Connecting with others - Your own idea Further questions: 1. Why do many people want to share videos on the Internet? 2. How do you think video sharing will change in the future? 3. Are there any drawbacks to sharing videos online?
